snippet.title: FlippUp - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
You've activated an old Pinball machine, but with a twist. No points to score, just a mysterious mission to reach the top. 
We recommend you to try the demo before buying to avoid quick refunds- FlippTechINC.

Game available on Steam- https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854060/FlippUp/
